issue.title: api.ipfy.org
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Ads) [NSFW] [https://api.ipfy.org/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.ipfy.org%2F) ### Comment > ALL host on ipfy.org domain contain some mechanism of either redirect by 302 on header or custom made JavaScript to load unwanted contents directly on browser window. Hosts of this domain reply custom made http request reply based on user agents. It is very easy to reproduce. I am giving here list of host I found under this domain. Both https and http request get customize reply. > > ipfy.org > www.ipfy.org > API.ipfy.org > api6.ipfy.org > WW1.ipfy.org > All above host provide HTTP and HTTPS servers replying nasty stuff including NFSW content. Please do verify, I am out of my place and posting this report from my Android phone. Very hard to keep typing on it. Thank you for your great service. We feel much safer using your filtering DNS servers. ### [NSFW] Screenshots [Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/2zo15a5mt2skcswwo80wwogsk4w4cg8fwrm8ge24mg.png?nc=1) ### System configuration | Information | Value | |-------------|-------| AdGuard product: | AdGuard DNS DNS setup: | Router DNS server: | Private System version: | `ZTE F679F ONT ` Browser: | Samsung tv browser, Chrome, curl for deep investigate Blocklists: | **AdGuard:**
